name: org.machanism.machai:ghostwriter
description: Machai Ghostwriter is a Java 8 command-line and embeddable AI-assisted guided file-processing engine. It scans Maven projects, folders, files, glob patterns, and regular-expression paths; discovers explicit @guidance instructions in source code, Markdown, HTML/XML, PlantUML, Python, TypeScript, and dedicated @guidance.txt files; and delegates each supported format to a reviewer before sending project-aware prompts to a configured GenAI provider. Ghostwriter supports repository-wide documentation maintenance, source-comment updates, test and quality workflows, and repeatable CI/CD automation. Its TOML-based Acts provide reusable workflows with defaults, inheritance through basedOn and ${super.value}, YAML prompt front matter, selected function tools, model overrides, shared project context, and multi-step episodes. Host-side tools offer controlled project-relative file access, patches, command execution and log inspection, web and REST access, Act orchestration, and guidance processing. The Ghostwriter CLI selects Guidance mode by default or Act mode with --act, and is distributed as the Maven artifact org.machanism.machai:ghostwriter.

constructors.description: Creates a processor that scans a project for embedded guidance tags and sends reviewer-normalized instructions to the configured GenAI provider.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.GuidanceProcessor processor = new org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.GuidanceProcessor(new java.io.File("."), "OpenAI:gpt-4.1", configurator);
processor.scanDocuments(new java.io.File("."), "glob:**/*.md");
examples.description: In an embedding application, create the processor with a project directory, provider identifier, and configured org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator, then scan Markdown guidance files.

constructors.description: Creates a processor for TOML-defined reusable Acts, including inherited configuration, episodes, prompt processing, and shared project context.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.ActProcessor processor = new org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.ActProcessor(new java.io.File("."), "OpenAI:gpt-4.1", configurator);
processor.setAct("task Summarize the project documentation");
examples.description: Create an Act processor and select the built-in task Act with a practical project request before processing the project layout.

features.name: Ghostwriter CLI entry point
features.signature: public static void org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.Ghostwriter.main(java.lang.String[] args) throws java.io.IOException, org.apache.commons.cli.ParseException
features.description: Runs Ghostwriter from the command line. It resolves CLI and persisted configuration, selects Guidance mode or Act mode, processes requested paths, and returns a suitable process result.

examples.snippet:
1. Download and unpack the Ghostwriter CLI delivery pack from https://sourceforge.net/projects/machanism/files/machai/ghostwriter/gw.zip/download.
2. Configure provider credentials and select a model, for example in gw.properties or environment-supported provider configuration.
3. Run: java -jar gw.jar --projectDir . --model "OpenAI:gpt-4.1" "glob:**/*.md"
4. Review the changed documentation and repeat with narrower guidance when needed.
examples.description: Installs, configures, and runs the ready-to-use CLI to process guided Markdown documentation in the current project.

features.name: Scan guided documents
features.signature: public void org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.AIFileProcessor.scanDocuments(java.io.File projectDir, java.lang.String path) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Scans a project directory using a relative path, glob expression, or regular expression. GuidanceProcessor uses this facility to find supported files and apply embedded or default guidance.

examples.description: Processes only guided Markdown pages beneath the project documentation folder.

features.name: Configure and load an Act
features.description: Loads a named TOML Act, applies inheritance and defaults, records trailing request text as public.prompt, and supports episode selection such as review#1,2!.

examples.snippet:
processor.setActsLocation("acts");
processor.setAct("review#1,2! Check public API documentation");
examples.description: Loads custom Acts from the project acts directory and runs only the first two review episodes before stopping normal episode progression.

features.name: Apply a targeted patch
features.signature: public java.lang.String org.machanism.machai.gw.tools.FileFunctionTools.applyPatchToFile(java.io.File file, java.lang.String patch, java.lang.String charsetName, java.io.File projectDir)
features.description: Applies a standard unified diff or exact simplified search-and-replace patch to a project file, enabling focused and reviewable AI-assisted edits.

examples.description: Use this simplified patch body with the apply_patch_to_file tool to replace a documentation heading without rewriting the entire file.

features.name: Execute controlled system commands
features.signature: public java.lang.Object org.machanism.machai.gw.tools.CommandFunctionTools.executeCommand(java.lang.String command, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String> properties, java.lang.String dir, int tailResultSize, java.lang.String charsetName, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Runs allowed commands inside a project-relative working directory, captures bounded output in a persisted log, and supports later log paging and regular-expression searches.

examples.description: In an Act or host integration, run Maven tests after documentation or source changes and inspect the returned command log if validation fails.

examples.title: Install, configure, and run the Ghostwriter CLI
steps: Download and unpack gw.zip from the Ghostwriter SourceForge delivery-pack link.
Configure a supported GenAI provider and credentials, then choose a provider:model value such as OpenAI:gpt-4.1.
Add an HTML guidance comment containing @guidance to a Markdown file, or create @guidance.txt in a folder.
Review generated changes, refine the version-controlled guidance, and rerun the command in local automation or CI.
examples.description: This end-to-end scenario uses the packaged CLI to maintain project documentation with explicit, reusable guidance.

examples.title: Run a reusable Act
steps: Create or configure an Acts directory containing a TOML workflow that uses ${public.prompt} in its inputs.
Optionally define [default] public.prompt for a useful fallback request.
Run java -jar gw.jar --projectDir . --act "task Summarize project risks and documentation gaps".
For a multi-step Act, select episodes with an Act name such as review#1,2!.
Use interactive Acts when follow-up information is needed; enter . to finish or > to continue without a new message.
examples.description: This scenario configures and invokes a practical TOML-based workflow for project-wide analysis.
